n6df4c605e2.headline: Lithuanian president signs 2021 budget bill into law
n6df4c605e2.summary: Lithuanian President Gitanas Nausėda signed the 2021 budget bill into law, setting the fiscal framework for the year.
n6df4c605e2.why: Budget approval is a key fiscal policy event that affects government spending, taxation, and economic outlook, important for investors monitoring Lithuania's economy.

n15a0f493c4.headline: Electricity prices increased by 3.5 tetri in Tbilisi and regions
n15a0f493c4.summary: Electricity tariffs increased by 3.5 tetri for households and approximately 11 tetri for commercial consumers in Tbilisi and surrounding regions.
n15a0f493c4.why: Rising electricity costs impact business operating expenses and consumer spending in Georgia's economy.

n151c3ef729.headline: Water will become more expensive for Prague residents next year, a cubic meter will cost 92.36 crowns. The pandemic is also to blame | Aktuálně.cz
n151c3ef729.summary: Prague residents will face higher water prices next year, with a cubic meter costing 92.36 crowns, driven by reduced consumption during the COVID-19 pandemic and repair costs for the Podolí water treatment plant.
n151c3ef729.why: Utility price changes affect household expenses and municipal budgets, reflecting pandemic-related economic pressures in the Czech Republic.

n7f1f08152e.headline: Gakharia: The state will fully cover the increased water tariff for the socially vulnerable

n7f1f08152e.why: Government subsidies on utilities help protect vulnerable populations and maintain social stability during economic downturns.
